results.name: object_decal_color_direction_build
results.evidence: Converts an RGB color (in_ECX) to luminance via the 0.299/0.587/0.114 weights, writes a type tag of 2 plus clamped color/direction/saturation fields into a ~0x1d-float output block (unaff_ESI), randomizes a hemisphere direction via FUN_006283c0, then rescales the color through FUN_004f3410 when bit 2 of param_1 is set.
results.summary: Builds a per-effect parameter block (color, randomized direction, saturation thresholds) from an object's base/damage colors and normal vector, likely feeding a decal or particle-effect spawn; register args: byte param_1 flags, float *param_2 (position/normal), float param_3, plus in_EAX/in_ECX/in_EDX color pointers and unaff_ESI output block.

results.name: color_rgb_scale_to_intensity
results.evidence: Finds max(r,g,b) of the color pointed to by in_ECX, derives a clamped scale factor bounded by param_1+1.0, and multiplies all three channels by it - a standard HDR/self-illumination intensity clamp.
results.summary: Rescales an in-place RGB color vector (in_ECX) so its brightest channel does not exceed an intensity target derived from param_1.

results.name: object_control_word_field_extract
results.evidence: Switches on selector unaff_ESI (0..5) to extract a distinct 3-bit field (shifts of 4,7,10,0x10,0x13,0xd) from a packed control word (DAT_006f1cec or DAT_006f1ce8, chosen by in_EAX!=1), refreshing the word via FUN_00465380 when its low nibble isn't 8.
results.summary: Extracts one of six 3-bit sub-fields from a cached/refreshed packed control-configuration word, selected by an implicit selector register.

results.name: object_control_binding_table_reset
results.evidence: Zeroes a 6-slot x 8-entry table at DAT_008603e4.. (each entry populated via FUN_004f3680) and copies a per-slot pointer from the global player structure at DAT_00746fa0+0x168+0x24 when DAT_006f1d20 is set.
results.summary: Rebuilds the object/network control-binding lookup table used to associate machines or players with controlled objects.

results.name: object_control_binding_register
results.evidence: Searches the DAT_008603ec id table for a matching in_EDX id to find a machine-slot index, then, gated by a bit test on DAT_006f1cb8/unaff_EBX, stores unaff_EDI (object id) and a truncated unaff_EBX into the DAT_008603f0/DAT_008603f6 slot arrays built by object_control_binding_table_reset.
results.summary: Records that a given object/id (register args) is now bound to a slot in the control-binding table, subject to a per-controller-type bit filter.

results.name: object_control_binding_table_update_a
results.evidence: Mirrors object_control_binding_table_update_b's slot-comparison logic against DAT_008603e0/00860434/00860430, but dispatches to a jump table (PTR_LAB_004f39bc indexed by DAT_006f1cb8-1) when DAT_006f1ce8's low nibble is 0.
results.summary: Updates one variant of the control-binding table, assigning pending entries to left/right sub-slots by comparing counter thresholds, with a controller-type-specific jump-table fallback.

results.name: object_control_binding_table_update_b
results.evidence: For the first two machine-id groups (iVar7<2), marks up to iVar2 pending entries as bound (DAT_008603f4[..]=1) or, when DAT_006f1cec/DAT_006f1ce8's low nibble is 0, dispatches through the PTR_LAB_004f3abc jump table.
results.summary: Alternate control-binding table update pass, flagging pending bindings as active or deferring to a per-controller-type jump table.

results.name: object_control_binding_query
results.evidence: Finds param_1's machine slot in DAT_008603ec, then scans up to 3 entries of that slot's DAT_008603f0 array for a match on param_1, returning the corresponding DAT_008603f4 byte (defaulting to 1/true when no binding table is active or no match is found).
results.summary: Looks up whether object/id param_1 has a recorded control binding and returns its stored flag, defaulting to true when unbound or the table is inactive.

results.name: objects_update_network_control
results.evidence: Calls object_control_binding_table_reset, then (when DAT_00719720==2) iterates the object type at PTR_PTR_0069bfe0 registering entries via object_control_binding_register, then (when DAT_006f1d20) runs object_control_binding_table_update_a/b, then loops all 12 object types (skipping a 0x240 type mask) calling FUN_004f9b70 and objects_garbage_collection per object.
results.summary: Per-tick orchestrator that rebuilds and applies the network/local control-binding table across object types, then runs a follow-up transform+garbage-collect pass on affected objects (param_1: register-passed index/context).

results.name: object_type_definition_chain_build
results.evidence: Walks the 12-entry PTR_PTR_0069bfdc object-type table and each type's up-to-16-entry sub-definition array (offset +0x80), chaining every definition into one singly linked list via the +0xc0 field, then invokes each node's +0x14 vtable slot once.
results.summary: Builds a combined linked list of all object-type sub-definitions and calls each one's initialization vtable hook (offset +0x14).

results.name: object_type_definitions_notify_0x24
results.evidence: Resolves the object's type table (PTR_PTR_0069bfdc indexed via the object's 0xb4 field) and calls every non-null vtable function at offset +0x24 across its sub-definition array, no arguments passed.
results.summary: Broadcasts an argument-less event to every sub-definition of an object's type through vtable slot +0x24; object index passed in an implicit register.

results.name: object_type_definitions_query_0x28
results.evidence: Iterates the object type's sub-definition array calling vtable slot +0x28 with param_1, stopping early and returning false the first time a callback returns 0; returns true if every present callback succeeds.
results.summary: AND-style predicate dispatch: calls every sub-definition's +0x28 hook with param_1 and returns true only if none of them report failure.

results.name: object_type_definitions_query_0x28_tail
results.evidence: Same loop shape and vtable-offset-0x28 call pattern as object_type_definitions_query_0x28 but starts mid-stream from already-set unaff_ registers and has zero callers, indicating it is a Ghidra-split shared tail rather than a real entry point; the pre-existing name 'index_resolution_table_translate' does not match any index-table lookup visible in the code.
results.summary: Decompiled fragment duplicating the tail of the +0x28 predicate-dispatch loop; likely a shared code tail with no independent callers rather than a distinct function.

results.name: object_type_definitions_notify_0x2c
results.evidence: Iterates the object type's sub-definition array calling vtable slot +0x2c with (param_1,param_2) for every non-null entry, unconditionally.
results.summary: Broadcasts a two-argument event to every sub-definition of an object's type through vtable slot +0x2c.

results.name: object_type_definitions_notify_0x30
results.evidence: Same iteration pattern calling vtable slot +0x30 with no arguments for every sub-definition of the current (unaff_EBX) object's type.
results.summary: Broadcasts an argument-less event to every sub-definition of an object's type through vtable slot +0x30.

results.name: object_type_definitions_query_0x34
results.evidence: Iterates the sub-definition array calling vtable slot +0x34 with param_1, OR-accumulating the boolean results across every entry (uVar5 set to 1 if any callback returns non-zero).
results.summary: OR-style predicate dispatch: calls every sub-definition's +0x34 hook with param_1 and returns true if any of them reports success.

results.name: object_type_definitions_notify_0x38
results.evidence: Same unconditional broadcast pattern calling vtable slot +0x38 with no arguments across the object type's sub-definitions.
results.summary: Broadcasts an argument-less event to every sub-definition of an object's type through vtable slot +0x38.

results.name: object_type_definitions_notify_0x3c
results.evidence: Same unconditional broadcast pattern calling vtable slot +0x3c with no arguments.
results.summary: Broadcasts an argument-less event to every sub-definition of an object's type through vtable slot +0x3c.

results.name: object_type_definitions_notify_0x40
results.evidence: Same unconditional broadcast pattern calling vtable slot +0x40 with no arguments.
results.summary: Broadcasts an argument-less event to every sub-definition of an object's type through vtable slot +0x40.

results.name: object_type_definitions_query_0x44
results.evidence: Iterates the sub-definition array calling vtable slot +0x44 with param_1, OR-accumulating the boolean results, mirroring object_type_definitions_query_0x34.
results.summary: OR-style predicate dispatch through vtable slot +0x44: returns true if any sub-definition's hook reports success for param_1.

results.name: object_type_definitions_notify_0x48
results.evidence: Broadcasts (param_1,param_2) to vtable slot +0x48 across every non-null sub-definition, unconditionally.
results.summary: Broadcasts a two-argument event to every sub-definition of an object's type through vtable slot +0x48.

results.name: object_type_definitions_notify_0x4c
results.evidence: Same unconditional no-argument broadcast pattern calling vtable slot +0x4c.
results.summary: Broadcasts an argument-less event to every sub-definition of an object's type through vtable slot +0x4c.

results.name: object_type_definitions_notify_0x50
results.evidence: Same unconditional no-argument broadcast pattern calling vtable slot +0x50.
results.summary: Broadcasts an argument-less event to every sub-definition of an object's type through vtable slot +0x50.

results.name: object_type_definitions_notify_0x54
results.evidence: Same unconditional no-argument broadcast pattern calling vtable slot +0x54.
results.summary: Broadcasts an argument-less event to every sub-definition of an object's type through vtable slot +0x54.

results.name: object_type_definitions_notify_0x5c
results.evidence: Same unconditional no-argument broadcast pattern calling vtable slot +0x5c (note the family skips +0x58, implemented separately at 0x4f4480).
results.summary: Broadcasts an argument-less event to every sub-definition of an object's type through vtable slot +0x5c.

results.name: object_type_definitions_notify_0x58
results.evidence: Same unconditional no-argument broadcast pattern calling vtable slot +0x58, completing the gap left by object_type_definitions_notify_0x5c.
results.summary: Broadcasts an argument-less event to every sub-definition of an object's type through vtable slot +0x58.

results.name: object_type_override_get_0x64
results.evidence: Uses FUN_004f6ec0(-1) to get the 'current' object, then scans its type's sub-definition array from index 0xf downward for the first entry with a non-null function pointer at offset +100 (0x64), calls it, and returns its result.
results.summary: Finds the highest-priority sub-definition override for the current object and invokes/returns its +0x64 vtable hook, or 0 if none exists.

results.name: object_type_override_call_0x68
results.evidence: Same top-down override search as object_type_override_get_0x64 but targeting vtable slot +0x68, calling it with no return value used.
results.summary: Finds the highest-priority sub-definition override for the current object (via FUN_004f6ec0) and invokes its +0x68 vtable hook.

results.name: object_type_override_call_0x6c
results.evidence: Same top-down override search targeting vtable slot +0x6c, but resolves the object type directly from an implicit register (unaff_EDI) rather than via FUN_004f6ec0.
results.summary: Finds the highest-priority sub-definition override for a register-passed object and invokes/returns its +0x6c vtable hook.

results.name: object_type_override_call_0x70
results.evidence: Same top-down override search via FUN_004f6ec0 targeting vtable slot +0x70; falls back to calling FUN_004ec670 when there is no current object.
results.summary: Invokes the highest-priority sub-definition's +0x70 vtable hook for the current object, or FUN_004ec670 as a fallback when no current object exists.

results.name: object_marker_pool_release_and_notify
results.evidence: Pops the head of a free-list at (in_EAX+0x44) using the 'next' array at PTR_DAT_00687130+0x28, then tail-calls object_type_override_call_0x70(param_1).
results.summary: Releases one node back to a pooled free-list before dispatching the +0x70 object-type override for param_1.

results.name: object_datum_consume_pending_flag
results.evidence: Tests and clears bit 0x4000000 in the slot flags word at +0x10, and separately toggles a one-shot byte at +9 gated by bit 0x20 of the same word and a non-zero byte at +8.
results.summary: Tests and clears a pending-event flag on an object's slot descriptor (index via in_ECX), also consuming a related one-shot latch byte.

results.name: object_type_override_call_0x74
results.evidence: Same top-down override search pattern as the other 0x6x/0x7x dispatchers, targeting vtable slot +0x74, but defaults to returning 1 (true) instead of 0 when no override is found.
results.summary: Finds the highest-priority sub-definition override for a register-passed object and invokes its +0x74 vtable hook, defaulting to true when absent.

results.name: object_type_override_call_0x7c
results.evidence: Same top-down override search pattern targeting vtable slot +0x7c, void return.
results.summary: Finds the highest-priority sub-definition override for a register-passed object and invokes its +0x7c vtable hook.

results.name: objects_delete_unparented_of_type_mask
results.evidence: Iterates objects matching a fixed type-mask/size filter (0x240) via FUN_004f6f20; for entries with no marker link (+0xba==-1), reads the object type's category field (+4) and calls object_delete_immediate when it's 0 or object_delete_recursive when it's 3.
results.summary: Sweeps objects of two specific object types with no attached marker and deletes each one, immediately or recursively depending on its parent-role category.

results.name: objects_update_player_visibility_masks
results.evidence: For each of the 0x240-masked object types, transforms each object's marker into world space with matrix4x3_from_euler_angles/matrix4x3_transform_point, resolves the containing area via FUN_005013a0, and sets/clears bit DAT_0069e8d8 of a per-object 16-bit visibility mask at +0x20; optionally also garbage-collects/deletes stale entries when param_1 is set.
results.summary: Per-local-player pass that recomputes which objects of certain types are visible/relevant to the current local player and updates their per-player visibility bitmask, optionally pruning invalid ones.

results.name: objects_initialize
results.evidence: cea-pdb hint plus strings 'object','objects','collideable object','noncollideable object'; allocates the main object datum array via FUN_005380d0("object",0x800), a second array via FUN_00538150("objects"), builds the object-type definition chain, and registers CRC-tracked memory regions via crc32_update/cluster_partition_new.
results.summary: One-time module bring-up: creates the object and object-type data arrays, builds the type-definition chain, and registers the object memory regions for checksumming and cluster partitioning.

results.name: objects_reset
results.evidence: Clears free-list/counter globals, calls the object-type chain's +0x1c vtable hook for every node, then marks the object/unit/item/device category data arrays dirty (byte at +0x24) and calls data_delete_all on each, zeroing several 0x200-entry lookup buffers.
results.summary: Tears down all currently-existing objects and their per-category data arrays (object, unit-like, item-like, device-like) in preparation for a new map/game, without disposing the module's own state.

results.name: objects_flush_dirty_state
results.evidence: Calls the object-type chain's +0x20 vtable hook for every node, clears the 'dirty' byte at +0x24 on several category data-array headers, and re-validates existing object slots via FUN_004f7de0 using a data_get-style iteration (FUN_004d0630).
results.summary: Notifies each object type of a flush event and clears change-tracking flags on the object/category data arrays, re-validating any still-populated object slots.

results.name: objects_dispose
results.evidence: Calls 5 registered shutdown callbacks from the PTR_FUN_0069c024 table, invokes the object-type chain's +0x18 vtable hook for every node, then zeroes every object-category data-array pointer (DAT_00860b20/28/24, DAT_008603b0/d0/d8/d4/c0/c8/c4, DAT_006b8cb4) - the mirror-image teardown of objects_initialize.
results.summary: Final module shutdown: runs registered dispose callbacks and per-type dispose hooks, then clears every object/category data-array pointer the module owns.

results.name: objects_update
results.evidence: Copies/compares a double-buffered per-frame dirty bitset (DAT_006b8cbc), and for every populated object slot in DAT_008603b0's array dispatches object_mark_pending_delete/object_delete/object_delete_recursive style calls based on slot flag bits 0x40/0x20/0x1/0x4/0x8, finishing with objects_garbage_collection.
results.summary: Main per-tick object-array pass: reconciles the frame's changed-object bitset and processes each object's pending delete/create/activate flags before running garbage collection.

results.name: object_mark_pending_delete
results.evidence: Sets bit 0 of the object's slot-descriptor flags byte (+2) only when it isn't already set, the object's own flags word (+0x10) lacks bit 0x100000, and its owner field (+0x11c) is -1 (no owner).
results.summary: Flags an ownerless, non-persistent object's data-array slot as pending deletion (register arg: object index in in_EAX).

results.name: object_clear_pending_delete_flag
results.evidence: Clears bit 0 of the object's slot-descriptor flags byte at +2 if it is set - the inverse of object_mark_pending_delete on the same field.
results.summary: Clears the pending-delete flag previously set by object_mark_pending_delete (register arg: object index in in_EAX).

results.name: object_reset_default_scale_and_color
results.evidence: Copies two 3-float vectors from PTR_DAT_00696714 into the object's fields at +0x68/+0x6c/+0x70 and +0x8c/+0x90/+0x94, clears bit 0x20 of the flags word at +0x10, then calls object_type_definitions_notify_0x50.
results.summary: Resets an object's scale/tint fields to engine default values and notifies its type's sub-definitions (vtable +0x50).

results.name: object_set_velocity_and_orientation
results.evidence: Writes velocity fields (+0x5c/+0x60/0x64 from unaff_EDI), forward vector (+0x74/0x78/0x7c from param_2) and up vector (+0x80/0x84/0x88 from param_3, or a default computed via vector3d_normalize_with_length/FUN_004052c0 when param_3 is null), then calls object_type_override_call_0x70-family helpers FUN_004f8310/FUN_004f5c30.
results.summary: Sets an object's velocity plus forward/up orientation vectors (deriving a default up-vector when none is supplied) and re-links its cluster/parent state.

results.name: object_set_velocity_and_relink
results.evidence: Writes only the velocity fields (+0x5c/+0x60/+100) from unaff_ESI after calling FUN_005013a0/FUN_004f5de0 (object_unlink_from_cluster), then re-links via FUN_004f5c30 and FUN_004f8310.
results.summary: Sets an object's velocity vector and refreshes its cluster/placement linkage.

results.name: object_set_velocity
results.evidence: Writes the velocity fields (+0x5c/+0x60/+100) from unaff_ESI after calling object_unlink_from_cluster (FUN_004f5de0), then calls FUN_004f5c30, without the placement-transform call seen in object_set_velocity_and_relink.
results.summary: Sets an object's velocity vector and updates its cluster/parent linkage, a lighter variant of object_set_velocity_and_relink.

results.name: object_creation_parameters_initialize
results.evidence: Zeroes a 0x88-byte output struct (in_EAX, 0x22 dwords) then fills tag id (param_1), default bounding vectors from PTR_DAT_00696718/00696720, owner-object linkage via FUN_004f6ec0(-1), and 4 default vec3 fields from PTR_DAT_00686b04; the field layout (offsets 6-0x15) matches what object_new_with_datum_role_control later reads from its param_1.
results.summary: Builds and default-initializes the object-creation parameter block later consumed by object_new_with_datum_role_control, given a tag id (param_1) and parent-role value (param_2).

results.name: object_new
results.evidence: Body is a single tail call to object_new_with_datum_role_control with no additional setup visible, implying its arguments are simply forwarded through registers/stack from the caller.
results.summary: Thin wrapper entry point that forwards directly to object_new_with_datum_role_control.

results.name: object_new_with_datum_role_control
results.evidence: cea-pdb hint and string 'OUT OF OBJECTS: cannot create %s' printed via FUN_004c67c0/_sprintf on allocation failure; allocates a free slot from the object type's own sub-pool (FUN_004f7d50), copies placement/velocity/scale fields from param_1, sets slot/type flags, then runs the full post-creation notification sequence (object_type_definitions_* hooks, FUN_004f8310, object_set_cluster_and_parent, etc.) before optionally deleting itself on setup failure.
results.summary: Core object constructor: allocates a new object datum for a tag/type, populates it from a creation-parameter block (param_1) and role/control value (param_2), runs post-creation setup hooks, and logs an 'OUT OF OBJECTS' error and cleans up on failure.

results.name: object_delete_recursive
results.evidence: Recursively deletes the object's first-child link (+0x118) and, when param_2 is set, its next-sibling link (+0x114), sets slot flag bit 3 (+2 |= 8), clears the object's 'linked' bit (+4 &= ~1) via the retrieved datum pointer, and finalizes with FUN_004f9b00; also calls FUN_004f9a20 when the object still has role-control ownership.
results.summary: Recursively deletes an object along with its child/sibling hierarchy, marking each slot deleted and releasing role-control ownership before finalizing.

results.name: object_delete_immediate
results.evidence: Resolves the object's owning marker via FUN_004f05e0, invokes a script/engine deletion callback (FUN_004ec940), unlinks it from its cluster with FUN_004e9d40 unless slot flag bit 3 is already set, and fires an object-deleted notification through FUN_004e1a80 when children were affected.
results.summary: Performs the actual work of deleting a single object with no parent: notifies scripts, unlinks it from its cluster, and raises an object-deleted event.

results.name: object_delete_by_marker_pool_id
results.evidence: Resolves a pooled id (in_ECX) to an object index through the PTR_DAT_00687130+0x28 'next' table, checks FUN_004ec590/FUN_004f6ec0 conditions, and calls object_delete_recursive on the resolved object; falls back to FUN_004ec670 when the pointed-to field is already non-zero.
results.summary: Deletes the object associated with a pooled marker/attachment id after validating engine-state preconditions.

results.name: object_delete
results.evidence: Reads the object's parent-role field (via its datum pointer +4) and dispatches to object_delete_immediate when it is 0, or object_delete_recursive when it is 3; any other value is a no-op.
results.summary: Top-level object deletion entry point that dispatches to the immediate or recursive deletion path based on the object's parent-role category.

results.name: object_is_delete_pending
results.evidence: Returns bit 3 (0x8) of the object's slot-descriptor flags byte at +2, which is exactly the bit object_delete_recursive sets when marking a slot deleted.
results.summary: Tests whether an object's data-array slot has already been marked deleted by object_delete_recursive.

results.name: object_set_cluster_and_parent
results.evidence: When the object has no parent (+0x11c==-1), resolves its containing cluster/leaf via FUN_005013a0 (falling back to FUN_0053e780) and stores it at +0x98/+0x9c; otherwise re-parents it under an existing owner's child-list (+0x118/+0x114); finishes by calling FUN_00551f00 and conditionally invoking object_mark_pending_delete/object_delete.
results.summary: Assigns an object's containing cluster (if unparented) or links it into its parent's child chain, then updates cluster-membership bookkeeping and may trigger deletion of stale sub-objects.

results.name: object_unlink_from_cluster
results.evidence: When the object has no owner (+0x11c==-1), calls FUN_00552020 to remove it from cluster bookkeeping and clears its slot 'active' bit; when it does have an owner, checks FUN_004f6ec0 and calls FUN_004f8fe0 to notify the parent instead; clears the +0x10 'linked' bit either way.
results.summary: Removes an object from its current cluster/placement bookkeeping, or notifies its parent object when it is owned by one.

results.name: object_get_by_category_index
results.evidence: Looks up DAT_008603d0[param_2] to get an object id, then resolves its datum address through the DAT_008603d4 category data-array header, returning both the address (via *param_1) and a type/category value.
results.summary: Resolves an object id stored in a per-category index table (selected by param_2) to its datum address and category/type tag.

results.name: object_get_root_parent_placement
results.evidence: Walks the object's owner chain (+0x11c) up to the root object, selects DAT_008603d0 or DAT_008603c0 as the category array based on flag bit 0x2000000 at +0x10, then returns that root's marker placement field at +0x10c.
results.summary: Finds the outermost (unparented) ancestor of an object and returns its category data-array pointer and marker-placement id/address.

results.name: object_get_node_marker_address
results.evidence: Computes iVar1 + node-table-offset(+0x1f2) + param_1*0x34, i.e. the address of the param_1'th node/marker entry within an object's per-node array.
results.summary: Returns the address of a specific node/marker record (index param_1) within the current object's node array (object index in in_EAX).
